column1: # ZAP Baseline rule overrides for fedtracker-app.
# Default for every rule is WARN. The action passes/fails based on `fail_action: true`
# in security-scan.yml combined with each rule's threshold here. Set FAIL only for
# classes where any finding is unacceptable — the goal is "fail on HIGH severity".
# Cookie / session-fixation rules: fedtracker-app uses Bearer JWTs at the API
# Gateway tier (see ADR-015), not cookies. Cookie-set rules false-positive against

column1: # OpenAPI / Swagger UI hosted at /docs serves an inline script bundle. ZAP flags

# we ever ship our own UI.
# Anti-CSRF: API is JWT-authenticated and CORS-restricted at the gateway.
# CSRF mitigations are at the auth-token layer, not request-token form fields.
